description: List ad sets in a campaign, or across the whole ad account when campaignId is omitted. To find ad sets by name without knowing their campaign, omit campaignId and pass search (name contains); each row then includes campaignId and campaignName. status defaults to 'active', so pass 'all' to include paused ad sets. Returns one bounded page; follow paging.after for more. Use fields to return only the columns you need; large pages are trimmed to fit the output budget.

after.description: Opaque paging.after cursor. Keep filters unchanged.

campaignId.description: Meta campaign ID. Omit to list ad sets across the whole ad account, e.g. to find ad sets by name with search when the campaign is unknown; each row then includes campaignId and campaignName.

fields.description: Return only these output columns. id is always returned; money fields also keep their Minor twin and currency. status is the configured state; effectiveStatus is the effective delivery state. Either is null when Meta does not provide it. campaignName is returned only when campaignId is omitted. Omit for all columns; an empty array returns only id.

fresh.description: Accepted for compatibility; this list always reads fresh data.

offset.description: Offset within the fetched results. Requests fetch up to 500 rows. After budget trimming, use pagination.nextOffset with the same input after; consume remaining rows before following paging.after.

search.description: Optional ad set name search text (name contains). Works with or without campaignId.

status.description: Exact 'active' filters active/in-process delivery states (default); other values mean no status filter on existing campaign and parent-scoped lists. Without a parent ID, account-wide lists also support 'inactive' (non-active, excluding deleted) and 'archived' (archived only).

title: List Ad Sets
